title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Item 1A Risk Factors（半导体行业周期性自述）
key_points: AMD 在 10-K 风险因素中自述半导体行业「高度周期性」（highly cyclical），并称该行业经历过严重下行。
该文件将行业周期性归因于：持续快速的技术变革、供需的剧烈波动、持续的新产品推出、价格侵蚀，以及一般经济状况的下行。
AMD 称过去的下行期曾造成重大亏损，原因包括平均售价大幅下降与供需的周期性特征。
该文件将 2022 年下半年 Client 分部收入下滑归因于 PC 市场宏观环境疲弱与 PC 供应链的库存修正。
raw_excerpt: The semiconductor industry is highly cyclical and has experienced significant downturns, often in conjunction with constant and rapid technological change, wide fluctuations in supply and demand, continuous new product introductions, price erosion and declines in general economic conditions. We have incurred substantial losses in previous downturns, due to substantial declines in average selling prices; the cyclical nature of supply and demand

title: Boeing 2022 Form 10-K — Item 1A Risk Factors（航空业周期性自述）
key_points: Boeing 在 10-K 中自述航空业「一直是周期性的」（has been cyclical）且竞争激烈，经历过显著的利润波动。
该文件描述了一条传导链条：全球经济环境显著恶化 → 新飞机订单减少或客户推迟/取消合同订单与付款 → 收入、盈利能力、现金流下降、合同积压减少。
该文件指出 Boeing 的商用飞机积压订单由跨越数年的交付计划构成，因此宏观经济、行业或客户冲击可能长期影响交付。
该文件称 Boeing 收入的重要部分来自数量有限的商用航空公司客户。
raw_excerpt: airline industry has been cyclical and very competitive and has experienced significant profit swings and constant challenges to be more cost competitive. Significant deterioration in the global economic environment, the airline industry generally or the financial stability of one or more of our major customers could result in fewer new orders for aircraft or services, or could cause customers to seek to postpone or cancel contractual orders and/or payments to us, which could result in lower revenues, profitability and cash flows and a reduction in our contractual backlog.

title: Boeing 2022 Form 10-K — MD&A 行业展望（GDP 增速与飞机需求量的关联）
key_points: Boeing 将「经济增长」列为航空出行需求的基本驱动因素之一。
Boeing 的 Commercial Market Outlook 预测 20 年间客运与货运流量年增长率为 3.8%。
Boeing 基于全球 GDP 年均增长 2.6% 的长期预测，推导出未来 20 年约 41,170 架新飞机的需求。
该文件称该行业仍易受外生冲击影响，包括燃油价格飙升、信贷市场冲击、恐怖主义行为、自然灾害、冲突、流行病、大流行病及更严格的环境监管。
raw_excerpt: The long-term outlook for the industry remains positive due to the fundamental drivers of air travel demand: economic growth, increasing propensity to travel due to increased trade, globalization and improved airline services driven by liberalization of air traffic rights between countries. Our Commercial Market Outlook forecast projects a 3.8% growth rate for passenger and cargo traffic over a 20-year period. Based on long-term global economic growth projections of 2.6% in average annual gross domestic product, we project demand for approximately 41,170 new airplanes over the next 20 years.

title: BOEING_2022_10K — Item 7 MD&A: 行业长期展望与 Commercial Market Outlook 假设（p23）
key_points: Boeing 将 air travel demand 的根本驱动因素表述为：economic growth、因贸易增加与全球化带来的 travel propensity 上升、以及航空运输权自由化带来的服务改善。
Boeing Commercial Market Outlook 预测 20 年期内客运与货运交通量年增长率为 3.8%。
该预测基于全球 GDP 年均增长 2.6% 的长期假设，并据此推算未来 20 年约 41,170 架新飞机需求。
Boeing 同时声明行业仍易受外生冲击影响，包括燃油价格飙升、信贷市场冲击、恐怖主义、自然灾害、冲突、流行病/大流行病及更严格的环境监管。
raw_excerpt: The long-term outlook for the industry remains positive due to the fundamental drivers of air travel demand: economic growth, increasing propensity to travel due to increased trade, globalization and improved airline services driven by liberalization of air traffic rights between countries. Our Commercial Market Outlook forecast projects a 3.8% growth rate for passenger and cargo traffic over a 20-year period. Based on long-term global economic growth projections of 2.6% in average annual gross domestic product, we project demand for approximately 41,170 new airplanes over the next 20 years.

title: BOEING_2022_10K — Item 7 MD&A: 航空公司财务表现与新增运力需求（p22）
key_points: Boeing 明确表述 airline financial performance 会影响对新增运力（new capacity）的需求，即航空公司盈利状况是飞机需求的传导环节。
Boeing 引用 IATA 数据：2020 年全球航空业净亏损 1380 亿美元，2021 年净亏损 420 亿美元。
Boeing 引用 IATA 预测：2022 年全球航空业亏损 69 亿美元，其中北美盈利约 99 亿美元但被其他地区亏损抵消；2023 年全球预测盈利 46 亿美元。
上述内容为 Boeing 对 IATA 数据的二手引用，非 IATA 原始报告，亦未给出任何弹性或滞后估计。
raw_excerpt: Airline financial performance, which influences demand for new capacity, has been adversely impacted by the COVID-19 pandemic. According to the International Air Transport Association (IATA), net losses for the airline industry were $138 billion in 2020 and $42 billion in 2021. IATA also forecasts $6.9 billion of losses for the industry globally in 2022, with approximately $9.9 billion of profits in North America driven by the robust domestic market being more than offset by losses in other regions. For 2023, IATA is forecasting $4.6 billion in profits for the industry globally.

title: BOEING_2022_10K — 双寡头结构的公司自述与竞争者（p22 / p30）
key_points: Boeing 自述为 100 座以上飞机的主要两家制造商之一。
Airbus 在政府支持下长期重金投入，建立了与 Boeing 竞争的产品家族。
Airbus 于 2018 年收购 Bombardier C Series 多数股权（现 A220）后，继续扩展 100–150 座跨大陆市场。
COMAC 于 2022 年交付首架 C919，是处于不同开发阶段的竞争者之一。
737 MAX 停飞及多辖区交付暂停显著降低了 Boeing 在单通道飞机交付方面的市场份额，可能为竞争者提供获取更多订单与提升份额的机会。
raw_excerpt: We are one of the two major manufacturers of 100+ seat [airplanes] … With government support, Airbus has historically invested heavily to create a family of products to compete with ours. After the acquisition of a majority share of Bombardier's C Series (now A220) in 2018, Airbus continues to expand in the 100-150 seat transcontinental market. Other competitors are also in different phases of developing commercial jet aircraft, including Commercial Aircraft Corporation of China, Ltd. (COMAC), which delivered its first C919 aircraft in 2022.

title: BOEING_2022_10K — 需求侧周期性：IATA 行业盈亏与 20 年流量预测（p22 / p23）
key_points: 据 IATA，航空业净亏损 2020 年为 $138B、2021 年为 $42B。
IATA 预测 2022 年全球行业亏损 $6.9B，其中北美盈利约 $9.9B，被其他地区亏损抵销。
IATA 预测 2023 年全球行业盈利 $4.6B。
Boeing Commercial Market Outlook 预测未来 20 年客运与货运流量增速为 3.8%。
公司称航空业长期前景仍正面，驱动因素为经济增长、出行倾向提升、贸易与全球化、以及航权自由化。
raw_excerpt: According to the International Air Transport Association (IATA), net losses for the airline industry were $138 billion in 2020 and $42 billion in 2021. IATA also forecasts $6.9 billion of losses for the industry globally in 2022, with approximately $9.9 billion of profits in North America driven by the robust domestic market being more than offset by losses in other regions. For 2023, IATA is forecasting $4.6 billion in profits for the industry globally. … Our Commercial Market Outlook forecast projects a 3.8% growth rate for passenger and cargo traffic over a 20-yea[r period]
